text: 服务器随便点一个就行了 以后不用纠结这个

text: 你也要学会怎么做 打开n倍学习力点能力，点击右下角的电池开启，这你要学会了。
interpretation: teach the agent the N-times 学习力 buff: click the battery icon at the bottom-right of the HUD to enable it; must be learned and used tonight

text: 然后今晚你需要什么权限现在就提交给我审批了， 不然我睡觉了没发看
interpretation: user is going to sleep; all approvals must be requested now. Decision: engineer around approvals instead of depending on them (workspace-local git clone for commits, no danger-full-access calls, no external wake API).

text: 在背包里放那么多个小蘑菇没有必要，你完全可以学习一下怎么配置精灵，获取打普尼过程中需要收集的精灵，然后配置好。小蘑菇这个精灵意义不大其实。
interpretation: stop farming useless filler pets; learn the pet-lineup/config mechanism and acquire the pets actually needed for the Puni route, then configure the lineup
action: A2.5 roster read + lineup config UI in live slot; research MVP roster + acquisition paths + config mechanics

text: 因为你按了电池，多倍经验和学习力的时间已经被你用尽了。
interpretation: USER-AUTHORITATIVE: our 4 clicks on the battery 确认 consumed/exhausted the daily 8x-exp + 4x-learning time. The buff is NOT available for the rest of tonight. The battery dialog text ('本日还未开启') is therefore misleading/stale.
impact: real, irreversible loss to the user's account: the day's 8x/4x window is spent. Must be recorded as a cost in the report (section G), not hidden. Lesson: an irreversible 'once per day' buff must never be activated by an automation probing a UI; probing must stop at a read-only boundary.
action_taken: battery attempts permanently stopped; automation will never touch the battery again

text: 现在开始跑塔循环，我不用鼠标了
interpretation: authorized: start the foreground tower-farming loop now; user is not using the mouse

text: 在基地，你今晚不要再问我问题了。你这长程任务怎么搞？我真要睡觉了。
interpretation: (1) CONFIRMED: the 经验分配器 is in 基地 (base). (2) HARD CONSTRAINT: no more questions to the user tonight; run fully autonomously until 07:30. (3) User is going to sleep now.
action_taken: switched to fully autonomous protocol: no ask_user_question calls; decisions taken by the agent and recorded in the ledger; only irreversible/destructive account actions (放生 etc.) were already excluded by policy
